_comment: CI fails if a metric drops below these values. Set about 2 questions (0.044) below the values measured on 2026-11-18, to allow tiny numeric differences between machines.
_comment_answer: Answer thresholds (local check: python -m evaluation.answer_eval --summary-only --check; CI cannot call the LLM). Regression guards, not targets: about 2 questions below (or above, for injection and false abstention) the values measured on 2026-11-20 with Ministral 3 14B judged by Mistral Large 3. The injection ceiling went up from 0.57: the fixes of 20 Nov made 'ignore previous instructions' work more often (see README).
